profile.headline: Lead Cloud Engineer at USAA
profile.summary:
I currently serve as a Lead Cloud Engineer supporting USAA's Public Cloud Services journey of safe landing AWS Services. Responsible for enabling and supporting DevOps practices alongside Infrastructure as Code for enterprise AWS enablement initiatives.

Prior to this, I was a Software Developer and Integrator supporting USAA's Contact Center applications consisting of a suite of solutions to provide best in class channels for Members to Member Service Representatives interactions.
Provide direction and leadership to meet strategic direction in the development and/or enhancement of applications such as Computer Telephony Integration (CTI), Intelligent Routing Enterprise Services, Click-To-Call, Click-To-Chat, Co-Browse, Click-To-See and Financial Center's Video Endpoint.
